info.title: DIGITALYCloud API
info.description: Hosting for Discord bots, Node.js apps, APIs and workers. All paths are relative to `/v1`. Timestamps are epoch milliseconds, dates `YYYY-MM-DD`, money in euros (integer cents internally). Errors: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "fields?" } }`. Session principals pick the team with `X-Team-Id` (or `?team=` on GET/EventSource); API keys are bound to one team. `x-permission` lists the team roles and the minimum API-key scope for each operation (null: API keys not accepted).

session.name: dgc_session
session.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by signup/login. Unsafe requests also need `X-CSRF-Token` (see GET /auth/csrf) and an allowed Origin.

apiKey.description: `Authorization: Bearer dgc_live_…` — team-bound, scope `read` or `full`, 120 requests/min.

message.description: User-facing message, shown as-is by the dashboard.

error.description: Extra details depend on the code, e.g. `checkoutUrl`/`operationId` (402), `retryAfter` (429).

plan.description: Highest plan in the active team (display only).

id.description: Existing id to keep, or a temporary id for a new row.

value.description: May be omitted for an existing id to keep the stored value.

cpu.description: % of the plan allocation (0 when not measured; see metricsAt)

env.description: Session requests only; never sent to API keys or over SSE.

repo.description: `owner/repo` (github) or an image reference (docker); empty for uploads.

anyOf.description: Owner only, while payment is outstanding.
